steps.title: Network Discovery
steps.description: Explore your network environment using basic diagnostic commands.
tasks: Find your IP address: `ifconfig` or `ip addr show`
Trace route to Google: `traceroute google.com` (or `tracepath google.com`)

verification.command: ping -c 1 8.8.8.8 2>&1 | grep -q '1 packets transmitted' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: DNS Lookups
steps.description: Practice resolving domain names to IP addresses.
tasks: Use dig for detailed info: `dig google.com +short`
Look up mail servers: `dig google.com MX +short`

verification.command: nslookup google.com 2>&1 | grep -i address && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: HTTP Requests with curl
steps.description: Make HTTP requests and inspect responses like a pro.

verification.command: curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}' https://httpbin.org/get | grep -q '200' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Port Scanning
steps.description: Check which ports are open and what services are listening.
tasks: Check if port 22 is open: `ss -tlnp | grep :22`
Find what's using a specific port: `lsof -i :80 2>/dev/null || ss -tlnp | grep :80`

verification.command: ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q '' && echo PASS || (netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q '' && echo PASS || echo FAIL)
